en_title: 33 New Details From the GTA 6 Launch Trailer
subtitle: 从军旅往事到惊天劫案
opus_summary: IGN从《GTA6》发售预告中梳理出33处新细节，涉及Jason的军旅往事、抢劫任务和配角。画面还展示了载具、野生动物与建筑破坏效果，但部分细节仍有待确认。

paragraphs.en: Yet another look at GTA 6 has come our way, which means it’s time to get forensic; we’ve gone through the new trailer with a fine-tooth comb to pick out all of the interesting details hidden within. From peeks at what’s in store for some of its most explosive missions, further insights into Jason’s military past, and more than one visit to a steamy shower, there’s plenty of new things to take a look at.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》又放出了新影像，是时候仔细研究一番了。我们逐帧细看了这支新预告，找出了其中隐藏的各种有趣细节。从部分火爆任务的片段，到Jason军旅生涯的更多线索，再到不止一次出现的热气腾腾的淋浴场景，这次有不少新内容值得一看。

paragraphs.en: Let’s not waste any more time. Here are the 33 details we spotted in the GTA 6 launch trailer.
paragraphs.cn: 不再耽搁了。以下就是我们在《GTA6》发售预告中发现的33处细节。

paragraphs.en: Multiple shots offer a closer look at Jason and paint a pretty clear picture of the kind of man we’ll be taking control of. We already knew that he was ex-military, but midway through the trailer we see him wearing a U.S. Army t-shirt that offers more details on his service.
paragraphs.cn: 多个镜头让我们得以近距离观察Jason，也让我们对这位将由玩家操控的角色有了相当清晰的认识。我们已经知道他曾经当过兵，而在预告片中段，他穿着的一件美国陆军T恤透露了更多服役经历。

paragraphs.en: 1. Firstly, the combat training school Jason seemingly trained at is located in North Fort Law. Long-time fans will recognise this as the military base from the very first Grand Theft Auto game. In that original game, it was located in the state of New Guernsey, but it’s more likely that the one Jason attended is in the State of Alderney, the HD universe’s take on New Jersey. We know that Lucia is from Liberty City, which is located in the neighboring State of Liberty – perhaps they met when Jason was stationed at the base?
paragraphs.cn: 1．首先，Jason似乎曾在一所位于North Fort Law的战斗训练学校受训。系列老玩家会认出，这正是初代《侠盗猎车手》中的军事基地。在初代游戏中，这座基地位于New Guernsey州，但Jason就读的那所学校更有可能位于奥尔德尼州，也就是高清宇宙中对应新泽西州的地方。我们知道Lucia来自自由城，而自由城位于邻近的自由州——或许两人就是在Jason驻扎于基地期间认识的？

paragraphs.en: 2. More prominent than that small print is the word “Marauder”, which matches the skull-and-parachute tattoo on Jason’s arm that we’ve seen in previous videos. The Marauders are presumably the unit he served in, and may be a reference to the real-life Merrill's Marauders, a 1940s special forces group. Its modern-day equivalent is the 75th Ranger Regiment, and so it’s likely that Jason was a ranger.
paragraphs.cn: 2．比那些小字更醒目的是「Marauder」（掠夺者）一词，与此前视频中Jason手臂上的骷髅降落伞纹身相呼应。「掠夺者」想必就是他服役时所在的部队，也可能是在致敬现实中活跃于20世纪40年代的特种部队「麦瑞尔突击队」。如今与这支部队对应的是第75游骑兵团，因此Jason很可能曾是一名游骑兵。

paragraphs.en: 3. It seems like Jason has fallen on tough times since he left the forces. “I got in some trouble in the army, didn’t leave on the best of terms,” he says in the trailer’s opening. “They don’t give loans, anything, to people like me.” With a situation like that, it’s no wonder Jason has resorted to crime. The cost of living is only going up!
paragraphs.cn: 3．Jason退伍后的日子似乎不太好过。他在预告片开头说道：「我在军队里惹了些麻烦，离开的时候闹得不太愉快。」「他们不给我这样的人贷款，什么都不给。」处境如此，也难怪Jason走上了犯罪道路。毕竟生活成本还在不断上涨！

paragraphs.en: 4. Thankfully, it seems like Jason’s experience in the Marauders has equipped him with all the tools for a very fruitful life of crime. We see him wading through water dressed in special forces-like infiltration gear, a pair of night-vision goggles on his head and a silenced assault rifle in his hands. He’s accompanied by two other men, and the trio seem to have disembarked from a boat. While the blush night sky certainly looks very Floridian (or should we say Leonidan), an odd reptile to the left of the scene appears to be a komodo dragon, which are native to Indonesia. Is this a flashback to a mission from Jason’s army days? Or is the reptile simply a native of Leonida’s wetlands, and Jason has perhaps called on some former squadmates to help with some kind of job?
paragraphs.cn: 4．好在Jason在Marauders的经历，似乎让他具备了在犯罪生涯中大展身手所需的全套本领。画面中，他身穿类似特种部队的潜入装备，头戴夜视仪，手持装有消音器的突击步枪，涉水前进。同行的还有另外两名男子，三人似乎刚从一艘船上下来。泛着淡红色的夜空确实很有佛罗里达州的味道（或者该说是Leonida州），但画面左侧一只模样奇特的爬行动物看起来却像科莫多巨蜥，而这种动物原产于印度尼西亚。这是在回忆Jason从军期间执行的一次任务吗？还是说，这只爬行动物只是Leonida湿地的本地物种，而Jason可能找来了几位昔日战友，帮忙干一票？

paragraphs.en: 5. Much of the criminal work we see committed across this trailer has something of a military feel to it. We later see Jason on a helicopter, dressed in a bulletproof vest and demonstrating a very professional demeanor. He’s joined by a dog, potentially pointing to not just Jason having a pet, but also being able to use them as some kind of working dog. Later shots also show Jason confidently disembarking a chopper and checking the chambered round in his rifle – all small details, but ones that help paint the picture of a deeply competent professional.
paragraphs.cn: 5．预告片中展示的许多犯罪行动，都带着几分军事行动的味道。后面的画面里，Jason身穿防弹背心坐在直升机上，举止十分专业。他身边还有一只狗，这或许不仅暗示Jason养了宠物，还暗示玩家能让狗协助执行某些任务。再往后的镜头中，Jason从容地走下直升机，检查步枪膛内的子弹。这些都是小细节，却共同勾勒出了一位能力出众的专业人士。

paragraphs.en: 6. Lucia may not have Jason’s highly trained background, but it looks like she’ll eventually adopt at least some of his tactics. A minute into the trailer, we can see her dressed in special forced black and equipped with a Shrewsbury rotary grenade launcher, popping explosives into pursuing police vehicles.
paragraphs.cn: 6．Lucia或许没有Jason那样训练有素的背景，但她似乎最终至少会学会他的一部分战术。预告片播放到一分钟时，可以看到她身穿特种部队风格的黑色服装，手持Shrewsbury转轮式榴弹发射器，向追击的警车发射榴弹。

paragraphs.en: 7. She’s demolishing those cars from on high, hanging from the side of some kind of cargo net. A few seconds later, we see a helicopter carrying a giant load in a very similar cargo net – it seems likely that these shots are taken from the same mission, and that Lucia will hang from the net before or after it’s been dragged through the side of a skyscraper.
paragraphs.cn: 7．她挂在某种货网上，从高处炸毁这些车辆。几秒后，画面中出现了一架直升机，用非常相似的货网吊着一大批货物。这些镜头很可能来自同一个任务，而Lucia挂在货网上的这一幕，应该发生在货网被拖着撞穿摩天大楼外墙之前或之后。

paragraphs.en: 8. The damage caused by the crash is more detailed than anything we’ve seen in prior GTA games, with hundreds of shards of glass erupting from the side of the building. While this shot alone is far from confirmation that the game will feature Battlefield-like destruction tech, it is a flashy insight into just how detailed Rockstar is able to make environmental demolition.
paragraphs.cn: 8．这次撞击造成的破坏，比我们在以往任何一部《侠盗猎车手》游戏中见过的都更精细，数以百计的玻璃碎片从大楼侧面飞溅而出。虽然仅凭这个镜头，还远不足以确认游戏会采用类似《战地风云》的破坏技术，但这段炫目的画面让我们看到了Rockstar能把环境破坏做得多么细致。

paragraphs.en: 9. That kind of collateral damage is to be expected from crime on the scale that GTA typically depicts, and it seems like this game has no intention of being smaller than GTA 5’s biggest moments. We can see Lucia leaping off a car onto a commercial liner, suggesting something on the same scale as some of Trevor’s airborne antics. This shot is likely the precursor to the scene in the second trailer that shows Lucia fighting in a plane’s hold as its landing gear deploys.
paragraphs.cn: 9．以《侠盗猎车手》系列通常描绘的犯罪规模，出现这样的附带破坏并不意外，而本作似乎也无意在场面规模上逊于《GTA5》中最宏大的那些桥段。画面中，Lucia从一辆车上跃向一架民航客机，暗示这段情节的规模可与Trevor的某些空中特技场面相媲美。这个镜头很可能衔接的是第二支预告片中的一幕：飞机正在放下起落架，Lucia则在货舱内搏斗。

paragraphs.en: 10. The aforementioned chopper mission is probably a heist, but what’s definitely a heist is the bank job we see. This is actually the vault we previously saw in a screenshot we exclusively debuted back in August , complete with the burning bank notes and Lucia with her hair in a ponytail.
paragraphs.cn: 10．前面提到的直升机任务很可能是一次抢劫，但预告中那场银行劫案肯定是。这其实就是我们此前在8月独家首发的截图中见过的金库，燃烧的钞票和扎着马尾的Lucia也都在画面中。

paragraphs.en: 11. For that shot, Lucia is joined not by Jason but by another anonymous character. We can’t see their face, but whoever they are, it looks like we won’t be alone when conducting heists. In a later shot we see Lucia accompanied by gunmen disguised as construction workers, suggesting we’ll often be joined by crews of criminals. But will these be supporting characters introduced as part of the story, or NPCs hired to help, akin to how heist crews worked in GTA 5?
paragraphs.cn: 11．在这个镜头中，与Lucia同行的不是Jason，而是另一名身份不明的角色。我们看不到这名角色的脸，但无论对方是谁，看起来我们实施抢劫时都不会孤身一人。在后面的一个镜头中，Lucia身旁还有几名伪装成建筑工人的枪手，这暗示我们身边可能经常会有犯罪团伙成员同行。但他们会是随剧情登场的配角，还是像《GTA5》的抢劫团队那样，由玩家雇来帮忙的NPC？

paragraphs.en: 12. While stealing physical money is a tried and tested form of securing dosh, there’s a chance that GTA 6 will toy with a more decentralised approach, too. We see a bi-plane flying over Vice City’s beach, its side emblazoned with the logo for “DacityCoin”. That’s presumably some kind of Bitcoin parody, but why is it so prominent in the trailer? Why is there a guy hanging onto the plane’s wing and deploying a bright pink smoke flare? Our theory is that Jason and Lucia will take part in some kind of scam, and this is a stunt to advertise a bogus cryptocurrency.
paragraphs.cn: 12．抢现金是久经验证的捞钱手段，不过《GTA6》也有可能尝试更去中心化的路子。我们看到一架双翼飞机飞过罪恶都市的海滩，机身侧面醒目地印着「DacityCoin」的标志。这大概是在恶搞比特币，但它为什么会在预告片里如此抢眼？为什么还有个人攀在机翼上，放出亮粉色的烟雾信号？我们的猜测是，Jason和Lucia会参与某种骗局，而这场特技表演是在为一种虚假的加密货币打广告。

paragraphs.en: 13. Planes aren’t the only high-speed thrills on show. A little later we see street racing, a side activity we first saw in August’s extended look.
paragraphs.cn: 13．预告中展现的高速刺激体验不只有飞机。稍后我们还看到了街头竞速，我们在8月的加长展示中首次见到了这项支线活动。

paragraphs.en: 14. Of course, most of GTA’s high-speed driving tends to be a race against the cops. A short car chase sequence sees one of our protagonists behind the wheel of a lime green supercar, fleeing police that arrive from all angles. It seems like every new trailer shows off new cars, and we get a very quick peek at the new Invetero Coquette, which can be glimpsed for a split second – look out for its turquoise-and-pink synthwave paint job.
paragraphs.cn: 14．当然，《侠盗猎车手》系列中的高速驾驶，大多是在和警察竞速。一段简短的追车画面中，一名主角驾驶着一辆青柠绿色超跑，逃避从四面八方赶来的警察。似乎每支新预告都会展示新车，这次我们也短暂瞥见了全新的Invetero Coquette，它只出现了一瞬间——留意那套绿松石色与粉色相间的合成器浪潮风格涂装。

paragraphs.en: 15. For those who prefer waves to asphalt, you might find more joy in the Shasa, which appears to be a new model of boat for GTA 6. We can see Jason and his buddy Cal working on one, buffing out the paintwork. This seems to be Jason’s reality at the start of the story – with his army days behind him, he’s working as a laborer at Brian’s Marina.
paragraphs.cn: 15．如果你更喜欢海浪而不是柏油路，那么Shasa或许更能让你尽兴，它看起来是《GTA6》中的一款新船。我们能看到Jason和他的朋友Cal正在给一艘Shasa干活，打磨抛光船身漆面。这似乎就是故事开场时Jason的生活：他已经结束军旅生涯，正在Brian的码头当工人。

paragraphs.en: 16. Brian’s business looks pretty busy – the rental racks are full of boats and jet skis – but the state of Leonida is home to much bigger companies than local traders. In the background of an early shot we can see a Globe Oil truck. We’ve seen Globe Oil in a couple of other games – you may recognise them from GTA 4, or even Chinatown Wars, in which we used the company’s oil to make fiery molotov cocktails.
paragraphs.cn: 16．Brian的生意看起来相当忙碌——租赁区的架子上摆满了船只和水上摩托——但雷奥奈达州可不只有本地商户，还有规模大得多的企业。在靠前的一个镜头背景中，我们能看到一辆Globe Oil的卡车。这家公司曾在另外几款游戏中出现，你可能在《GTA4》，甚至《侠盗猎车手：血战唐人街》中见过它。在后者中，我们还用过这家公司的汽油制作燃烧瓶。

paragraphs.en: 17. Talking of fiery, there’s definitely a flame burning between Lucia and Jason, who can be seen on an apartment balcony with a beach view. This is a different safehouse compared to the more humble home we saw in the extended look, suggesting that we’ll be moving up in the world as well as around it.
paragraphs.cn: 17．说到火热，露西亚和杰森之间显然也燃着爱火。镜头中，两人站在一间公寓的阳台上，能望见海滩。这处安全屋不同于加长版预告中那间更简陋的住所，暗示我们不仅会四处奔走，生活境况也会有所提升。

paragraphs.en: 18. “Are we gonna be okay?” asks Lucia. “We stuck together through everything. We just gotta get through it,” Jason replies, emphasising the on-the-run nature of the couple’s story. They won’t be alone, though, with plenty of other characters here to help them.
paragraphs.cn: 18．「我们会没事的吧？」露西亚问道。「我们经历了那么多，一直都在一起。这次也得撑过去。」杰森回答道，再次突出了这对情侣亡命天涯的故事基调。不过，他们并非孤立无援，还有不少角色会帮助他们。

paragraphs.en: 19. Hopefully Cal won’t be the sharpest mind on their side. Whenever we’ve seen him in the trailers so far, he’s always presented as a bit of a fool. We get to see him play with a pet snake, offering its forked tongue a peck on the lips.
paragraphs.cn: 19．但愿卡尔不是他们这边最聪明的人。到目前为止，他每次在预告片中露面，都显得有点傻乎乎的。这次我们看到他逗弄一条宠物蛇，还凑上嘴唇，轻轻亲了一下它分叉的舌头。

paragraphs.en: 20. Speaking of reptiles, an iguana can be spotted crossing the road, further reinforcing the variety in wildlife across the state of Leonida. GTA 6 will have an animal spotting system, allowing us to find and catalogue them all.
paragraphs.cn: 20．说到爬行动物，画面中还能看到一只鬣蜥横穿马路，进一步展现了雷奥奈达州野生动物的多样性。《GTA6》将设有动物观察系统，让我们寻找各种动物，并将它们一一记录在册。

paragraphs.en: 21. We get another quick look at the rap duo, Real Dimez, made up of Roxy and Bae-Luxe. We don’t yet know too much about them. Could they be friends or foes? We know they are signed to Only Raw Records, club mogul Boobie Ike’s company, but he remains much of a mystery to us, too.
paragraphs.cn: 21．由Roxy和Bae-Luxe组成的说唱二人组Real Dimez再次短暂亮相。我们对她们的了解还不多。她们会是朋友，还是敌人？我们知道，她们签约了夜店大亨Boobie Ike旗下的Only Raw Records，但Boobie Ike本人对我们来说也仍然充满谜团。

paragraphs.en: 22. Someone we know we won’t want to get on the wrong side of is Mendez, a Vice City Police Department officer, who can be briefly glimpsed in a single shot. He certainly feels like he’ll be one of GTA 6’s major antagonists, cutting a figure similar to Samuel L. Jackson’s Officer Tenpenny in San Andreas.
paragraphs.cn: 22．有一个人我们肯定不想招惹，那就是罪城警察局的警员Mendez。他只在一个镜头中短暂露面，但给人的感觉确实像是《GTA6》的主要反派之一，颇有塞缪尔·杰克逊在《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》中饰演的汤普尼警官的架势。

paragraphs.en: 23. We can see more police as multiple cop cars take the off-road approach to chase their suspect. These belong to Mariana County, a part of the map where the Leonida Keys are found.
paragraphs.cn: 23．接下来还能看到更多警察，多辆警车驶离公路，越野追捕嫌疑人。这些警车属于Mariana县，列奥尼达群岛就位于地图上的这片区域。

paragraphs.en: 24. When not hunting Jason and Lucia, it looks like the police still have plenty on their hands across the state. We get a close-up of what look like heavily tattooed gang members riding in a green car. One of them is sporting ink that reads “EW”; could it be a clue to what this gang is called? Take your guesses now.
paragraphs.cn: 24．看来，即使不追捕Jason和Lucia，警方在全州各地也有不少事情要忙。一个近景镜头展示了几名坐在绿色汽车里、看起来满身文身的帮派成员。其中一人身上文着「EW」；这会不会是帮派名称的线索？现在就来猜猜吧。

paragraphs.en: 25. And are the people sporting balaclavas and dancing around a stockpile of golden AKs part of some odd gang? They’ve either watched Harmony Korine’s Spring Breakers too many times or are just modelling the guns. The camera is peering at them through a digital lens, so maybe this could be a photoshoot or music video for one of Only Raw’s artists?
paragraphs.cn: 25．还有那些戴着巴拉克拉法帽、围着一堆金色AK步枪跳舞的人，难道也属于某个古怪的帮派？他们要么是看了太多遍哈莫尼·科林的《春假》，要么只是在拿着枪摆造型。画面是透过数码镜头拍摄他们的，所以这也许是在为Only Raw旗下某位艺人拍摄写真或音乐录影带？

paragraphs.en: 26. Back on the protagonist’s side, we get to see expert bank robber and a seeming accomplice of Jason and Lucia, Raul Bautista, threatening a man at a construction site. This area looks like it belongs to Schlott Construction, if this sign in the background is anything to go by. That company has appeared on vehicle liveries in GTA Online as part of the Import/Export update, but it looks like it will have more of a physical presence in the world of Leonida.
paragraphs.cn: 26．再看主角这边，我们能看到抢银行的行家Raul Bautista在建筑工地威胁一名男子。他似乎也是Jason和Lucia的同伙。从背景中的这块招牌判断，这片区域看起来属于Schlott Construction。这家公司曾随「进出口大亨」更新出现在《GTA Online》的载具涂装上，不过这一次，它看起来会在列奥尼达拥有更多实体设施。

paragraphs.en: 27. Raul appears to be enjoying his bullying, chomping on some chicken as he stomps on a man. Could this be a bucket from Cluckin’ Bell? If so, they’ve changed the design of their packaging considerably since the GTA San Andreas days, with a look borrowed from their real-life counterpart, KFC, seen here. I’m not sure about the quality of that chicken, though. There doesn’t look like there’s much meat on that drumstick.
paragraphs.cn: 27．Raul似乎很享受欺负人的过程，一边大口啃鸡肉，一边踩踏一名男子。这桶鸡肉会不会来自Cluckin’ Bell？如果是，那它的包装设计相比《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》时期可变了不少，从这里的画面来看，新包装借鉴了其现实原型肯德基。不过，我不太确定这鸡肉的品质如何，那根鸡腿看起来没多少肉。

paragraphs.en: 28. Jason is clearly more of a thigh man. He can be seen with his love, Lucia, as they help each other get clean in the shower. Nothing else to see here but two people who really care about each other’s hygiene. Such is his commitment to cleanliness that he even wipes the shower down with his hand as Lucia gives him a thank you kiss for helping out. Once more, a little later in the trailer, we get a look at them looking after each other. Lucia is on her tiptoes, presumably so she can reach high enough to wash Jason’s hair for him. Incredibly helpful. I hope her ankle tag is waterproof, otherwise this could all end in disaster.
paragraphs.cn: 28．Jason显然更偏爱大腿。画面中，他和爱人Lucia一起淋浴，帮彼此清洗身体。没什么别的可看，只是两个人非常关心对方的个人卫生罢了。他对清洁如此认真，甚至还用手擦拭淋浴间，而Lucia则给了他一个吻，感谢他的帮忙。预告片稍后的画面再次展示了两人互相照顾的情景。Lucia踮起脚尖，大概是为了够到Jason的头，帮他洗头。真是太贴心了。希望她的电子脚镣能防水，不然这一切可能会以灾难收场。

paragraphs.en: 29. Showering seems like a great idea, because GTA 6 looks like it will be a particularly sweaty game. We’ve heard about Rockstar’s absurdly detailed sweat tech , and now we get to see it in action thanks to a man flexing for us at the gym. I hope we don’t have to fight him.
paragraphs.cn: 29．洗澡看来是个好主意，因为《GTA6》看起来会是一款让人汗流浃背的游戏。我们已经听说过Rockstar那套细致到离谱的汗水技术，如今，一位在健身房向我们展示肌肉的男子，让我们看到了这套技术的实际效果。希望我们不用跟他打架。

paragraphs.en: 30. If we do, though, then bringing along some knuckle dusters might be a smart move. We can see Jason popping some on. This melee weapon has appeared in numerous GTAs, but was known as Brass Knuckles back in Vice City when we visited in the 1980s.
paragraphs.cn: 30．不过，如果真要打，带上指虎或许是个明智之举。画面中可以看到Jason戴上了指虎。这种近战武器在多部《侠盗猎车手》游戏中都出现过，不过，当我们在《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》中造访20世纪80年代的罪恶都市时，它的名字还是Brass Knuckles。

paragraphs.en: 31. To take down enemies more than a few feet away, Jason will need different weaponry. We see him holding a sniper rifle, and in the scope’s reflection we can spot a helicopter, ready to be taken down. In an earlier shot in the trailer, we could be witnessing the aftermath of Jason pulling the trigger, as he walks away with a helicopter crashing into a ball of flames behind him. As we know, cool guys don’t look at explosions. We can also spot an earpiece in - you’ll never guess it - his ear. Who’s speaking to him? Presumably not the pilot. Not anymore, at least.
paragraphs.cn: 31．要干掉几英尺以外的敌人，Jason就需要换种武器了。画面中，他手持一把狙击步枪，瞄准镜的反光里能看到一架直升机，就等着被击落。预告片更早的一处镜头，可能就展示了Jason扣动扳机后的情景：他迈步离开，身后的直升机坠毁，化作一团火球。众所周知，真男人从不回头看爆炸。我们还能发现，他戴着一只耳机，位置就在——你绝对猜不到——他的耳朵里。谁在跟他说话？想必不是飞行员。至少现在已经不是了。

paragraphs.en: 32. While we’re trying to piece bits of story together, the gold dress that Lucia is wearing at the end of this trailer is the same one prominently shown in Trailer 2. It looks like this could all be part of one big mission that starts on a yacht, heads to the Nine1Nine club, where at some point Jason and Lucia have to jump from the roof into its pool. Why do they need to escape? We’ll all get to find out very soon on November 19.
paragraphs.cn: 32．既然我们正在尝试拼凑剧情线索，不妨留意一下：Lucia在这支预告片结尾穿的金色连衣裙，正是第二支预告片中着重展示过的那一件。这些情节看起来可能都属于同一个大型任务：任务从一艘游艇开始，随后转到Nine1Nine夜店，Jason和Lucia还得在某个时刻从屋顶跳进夜店的泳池。他们为什么要逃跑？很快，到了11月19日，我们就都能知道答案了。

paragraphs.en: 33. Soundtracking the whole trailer is a new single recorded just for the game from French electronic duo Justice, who are also composing the game’s original score. “Flower in a Hurricane” also features the Australian psychedelic touch of Tame Impala, fellow Aussie rock band King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, and American singer-songwriter SZA. We’re yet to see an actual hurricane in all of our looks at GTA 6 so far, but we do know that extreme weather will play a part in the game.
paragraphs.cn: 33．贯穿整支预告片的配乐，是法国电子音乐双人组合Justice专为这款游戏录制的一首新单曲，他们也负责创作游戏的原创配乐。这首《Flower in a Hurricane》还汇集了带来澳大利亚迷幻风格的Tame Impala、同样来自澳大利亚的摇滚乐队King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard，以及美国创作歌手SZA。到目前为止，《GTA6》公开的所有画面中都还没有出现真正的飓风，但我们已经知道，极端天气会在游戏中发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: So, that’s what we found. Spot anything we may have missed? Let us know in the comments below. If you’ve missed any of our other trailer breakdowns or deep dives into the world of GTA 6, you can check them out here. Not long to go now. We’re almost there.
paragraphs.cn: 以上就是我们的发现。你有没有发现我们可能遗漏的细节？欢迎在下方评论区告诉我们。不用再等太久了，我们就快等到了。

paragraphs.en: Matt Purslow is IGN's Executive Editor of Features.
paragraphs.cn: Matt Purslow是IGN专题执行编辑。
